summary_en: 2,000 shares to be acquired on 2026-07-16 via ToSTNeT-3 at reference price ¥3,200/share for ¥6.4M total (0.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Order valid for single trading session only. Rationale: leverage debt-funded buyback to enable future flexible capital policy.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Share Purchase via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 15 July 2026, Yottavias's board resolved to acquire 2,000 of its own ordinary shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on the following day (16 July 2026 at 08:45 JST) at the reference price of ¥3,200 per share, for a total consideration of ¥6.4 million. The order is valid only for that single trading session; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Pct_so calculated as 2,000 ÷ 400,000 = 0.5%. The stated purpose is to enable flexible future capital allocation by deploying debt-funded buybacks to enhance corporate value. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 16,600 treasury shares out of 416,600 issued shares.
